observed: mkdir: can't create directory '/data/gitea/': Permission denied
s6-svscan: fatal: unable to open .s6-svscan/lock: Read-only file system (exit 111)
diagnosis.root_cause: the default image expects to start as root, with a writable /data and the s6 supervisor; AFD's mandatory hardening (non-root, read-only root, cap-drop ALL) prevents that, and contract v0 has no writable-path or config channel
also_blocking_in_v0: no auth/session bootstrap: issue creation via the web form needs a logged-in session cookie + CSRF token
scope (owner/repo) lives in the URL path
the web form posts application/x-www-form-urlencoded, not JSON
success is a 303 redirect, which v0's ledger does not count as an effect
diagnosis.candidate_workaround_without_source_chan: upstream's own rootless image variant (gitea/gitea:*-rootless) plus writable data paths
